archimate:BusinessActor.name: product owner
archimate:BusinessActor.documentation:
Guardian of the product vision and goal. All work is derived and prioritized based on the Product Goal in order to deliver value to all stakeholders
accountable for: maximizing the value of the product effective Product Backlog management: developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog Items ordering Product Backlog Items ensuring that the Product Backlog is transparent, visible and understood
